title: May I Not Hurt Your Heart
translation: O Earth, whatever I dig from you, may it quickly grow back. O purifier, may I not strike your vital points; may I not hurt your heart.
translation_hi: हे भूमि, मैं तुमसे जो कुछ खोदूँ, वह शीघ्र फिर उग आए। हे पवित्र करने वाली, मैं तुम्हारे मर्मस्थल को आघात न पहुँचाऊँ, तुम्हारे हृदय को चोट न पहुँचाऊँ।
science: An ancient prayer for sustainable use: take from the Earth only what can regrow. It is the core idea of soil conservation and responsible mining today.
